description.value: Refuge Tap Room is a 38-seat craft beverage bar on Fort Street in downtown Victoria, dedicated exclusively to BC-made products: 21 craft beers, five craft ciders, small-batch spirits, and wines on tap. A secluded back patio and a covered, heated courtyard make it a welcoming place to decompress at the end of a riding day. Sharable small plates—charcuterie, marinated olives, cured sausage—sourced from local providers round out the offering.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 5m; stands (2 spaces) at 15m; stands (8 spaces) at 18m; stands (2 spaces) at 23m; stands (8 spaces) at 39m; stands (2 spaces) at 46m; stands (4 spaces) at 85m; stands (4 spaces) at 90m. Total: 35 spaces.
